entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It hit me back at the bar, too, but...[n]You really are a renaissance man.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Sounds like you've got some friends[n]in high places, then.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...If you're trying to be unbelievably[n]smooth, it's working.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Especially earlier, when you went to[n]the staff to get our reservation.[n]You were so composed...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That was the most adult I've ever[n]seen you.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Sorry, I need to step out for a moment...
When should I give her the gift?

entries.speaker: Announcer
entries.en: Ladies and gentlemen, thank you for[n]joining us on this special day.

entries.speaker: Announcer
entries.en: We wish you all an unforgettable[n]evening, with one last finishing touch[n]from us...
I want you to have this.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: This seems unreal, like something[n]that only ever happens on TV.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Now that it's happening to me, I...[n]I don't know what to think. I'm just[n]so happy.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Is it because I don't have experience in[n]these things? Would I know what to[n]say if I'd dated someone before?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...You think so? But if I had, then...[n]Would I be this happy?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Really? Well, either way, I'm... so[n]happy right now.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You're right. I'm so happy right now...[n]Nothing else matters.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I guess you planned today out to the[n]smallest detail, huh?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Now that I think of it, this is just like[n]you.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Whenever you go to this much trouble,[n]it's always for someone else's sake...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I need to start following your example.
I'm sure you can pull it off.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Do you... have to be anywhere[n]after this?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: If not, um... We should spend some[n]more time together.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Wait, I-I don't mean to come off as[n]clingy or anything—

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Ugh, it's all this... romance in the air.[n]I don't know how to deal with it...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...Still, if it's just for one evening...[n]we can lean into it, right?
Makoto and I spent some[n]time alone together...
